mapper.select: SELECT a.hospital_cid, a.bedoc_id, a.hospital_site as bedoc_hospitalsite, a.bedoc_doctorname, a.bedoc_deptname, a.bedoc_hospitalname, a.new_hospitalname as hospital_name, a.new_hospital_hid as aiga_hid, a.new_doctor_url as hospital_site, case when a.new_site_type = '복수(리스트)' then 'list' when a.new_site_type = '팝업' then 'popup' else 'single' end as site_type, h.address as hospital_addr FROM hospital_bedoc_list as a left join hospital h on a.new_hospital_hid = h.hid WHERE 1=1 and is_getdetail_done = false and new_doctor_url != '' and new_doctor_url is not null and a.new_hospital_hid is not null and a.bedoc_id = 'A0329' ORDER BY a.hospital_cid ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT a.hospital_cid,a.bedoc_doctorname,a.bedoc_deptname,a.bedoc_doctor_site,a.bedoc_hospitalname,a.hospital_tel, a.hospital_name,a.hospital_addr,a.aiga_hid,a.hospital_site as hospitalsite, a.hospital_doctor_site as hospital_site FROM hospital_bedoc_list as a WHERE 1=1 and is_crawling_done = false and hospital_doctor_site != '' and hospital_doctor_site is not null ORDER BY a.hospital_cid ASC LIMIT 5 OFFSET 0

SELECT a.hospital_cid, a.aiga_hid, a.new_hospitalname as hospital_name, a.new_deptname as bedoc_deptname, a.new_doctorname as bedoc_doctorname, a.new_hospital_site as hospital_site, a.site_enable,a.alright,a.is_access_ok FROM hospital_bedoc_tmp_list as a WHERE 1=1 and is_access_ok = '1' ORDER BY a.hospital_cid ASC LIMIT 8 OFFSET 47
mapper.update: UPDATE hospital_bedoc_list set is_site_ok = #{isOk}, site_check_date = NOW() WHERE hospital_cid = #{cid}
UPDATE hospital_bedoc_list set hospital_doctor_site = #{hospital_site} WHERE hospital_cid = #{cid}

UPDATE hospital_bedoc_list SET search_doctor_site = #{doctorDetailUrl}, is_search_same_hospital = #{isSameHospital}, is_attend = #{isAttend}, search_type = #{isSearchType}, search_hospital_name = #{searchHospitalName}, is_site_ok = #{isExist}, is_crawling_done = 1, site_check_date = NOW(), crawling_done_cdate = NOW(), found_hospital_hid = #{foundHospitalHID} WHERE hospital_cid = #{hospital_cid}
mapper.select: SELECT a.hid as new_hid, b.address as hospital_addr,b.telephone FROM hospital_alias as a inner join hospital as b on a.hid = b.hid WHERE 1=1 and alias_name = #{newHospitalName}
SELECT a.hid as new_hid,a.alias_name, a.standard_name, b.address as hospital_addr,b.telephone FROM hospital_alias as a inner join hospital as b on a.hid = b.hid WHERE 1=1

SELECT a.rid_long,a.hid,h.baseName,a.deptname,a.doctorname,a.doctor_url FROM doctor_basic a INNER JOIN hospital h ON a.hid = h.hid and a.data_version_id = 3 LEFT JOIN hospital_bedoc_list c ON a.hid = c.found_hospital_hid and a.doctor_url = c.search_doctor_site and a.doctorname = c.bedoc_doctorname and a.deptname = ( ifnull(( CASE WHEN a.doctor_url LIKE '%deptname=%' THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.doctor_url, 'deptname=', -1), '&', 1) ELSE c.bedoc_deptname END ),a.deptname) ) WHERE a.data_version_id = 3 ORDER BY h.baseName asc, a.doctorname asc LIMIT 50 OFFSET 110
SELECT doctor_id FROM doctor WHERE rid_long = #{search_rid_long}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO doctor ( rid_long, rid, name, is_active, data_version_id, createAt ) values ( #{search_rid_long}, UNHEX(LEFT(SHA2(#{search_rid_long}, 256), 32)), #{search_doctorname}, 1, #{search_data_version_id}, now() )

INSERT INTO doctor_basic ( rid_long, rid, hid, doctor_id, data_version_id, deptname, doctorname, specialties, doctor_url, profileimgurl, new_hospitalname, new_doctor_url, createAt ) VALUES ( #{new_rid_long}, UNHEX(LEFT(SHA2(#{new_rid_long}, 256), 32)), #{new_hid}, #{new_doctor_id}, #{new_data_version_id}, #{new_deptname}, #{new_doctorname}, #{new_specialties}, #{new_doctor_url}, #{new_profileimgurl}, #{new_hospitalname}, #{new_doctor_url}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT a.data_version_id FROM doctor_career as a WHERE a.rid_long = #{search_rid_long} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO doctor_career ( rid_long, rid, data_version_id, jsondata, education, career, etc, createAt ) VALUES ( #{search_rid_long}, UNHEX(LEFT(SHA2(#{search_rid_long}, 256), 32)), #{search_data_version_id}, #{search_jsonData}, #{search_education}, #{search_career}, #{search_etc}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE doctor_career SET jsondata = #{search_jsonData}, education = #{search_education}, career = #{search_career}, etc = #{search_etc}, data_version_id_update = #{search_data_version_id}, updateAt = NOW() WHERE rid_long = #{search_rid_long}
mapper.select: SELECT a.paper_id FROM doctor_paper as a WHERE a.rid_long = #{search_rid_long} and a.title = #{search_title} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO doctor_paper ( rid_long, rid, data_version_id, doctorName, title, createAt ) VALUES ( #{search_rid_long}, UNHEX(LEFT(SHA2(#{search_rid_long}, 256), 32)), #{search_data_version_id}, #{search_doctorName}, #{search_title}, NOW() )
